pages.text: $(l)I lost my things when I died.$() They are in your $(l:systems/gravestones)gravestone$(/l) where you fell. Your $(item)Obituary$() lists them and the coordinates.

$(l)A boss healed after I fell back.$() Bosses recover when left alone. See $(l:bosses/overview)bosses/overview$(/l).$(br2)$(l)My compass will not find a structure.$() Some only appear in certain biomes or dimensions; the $(l:places/overview)Places$(/l) pages say where.

$(l)The game is slow or runs out of memory.$() See $(l:help/performance)Performance$(/l).$(br2)$(l)Two keys do the same thing.$() Options > Controls > Key Binds shows conflicts in red and has a search box.

$(l)Shaders look wrong.$() Press <key:iris.keybind.toggleShaders>, then try the Performance profile. Your world is unaffected.$(br2)$(l)This book is gone.$() See $(l:help/almanac)Getting This Book Back$(/l).
